Birdies Pizza & Perch · Night Guard, 12 AM–6 AM

Turn your phone sideways for the widest view.

Your first week

Survive
Stay alive from 12 AM to 6 AM. There are no doors.
Mask
When a bird gets into your office, put on the Silver mask right away and keep it on until they leave.
Vents
Hold a vent light to see what is crawling in. Sugar uses the left vent, Pikachu the right. Pikachu bangs pans in the Kitchen first (CAM 10, sound only).
Seeds
Your flashlight runs on seeds, and they never come back. Sugar won't hurt you, but if he reaches your desk he eats them and the light stays dark until he leaves. Put the mask on while he is in the left vent and he gives up.
Toy
Toy Silver is the shiny one with the bowtie. He walks the Main Hall and the hallway into your office. The light does nothing: put the mask on until he leaves.
Mercury
Mercury is the young cockatiel in the party hat. He moves fast and scrambles the camera he is on. When he reaches your office, put the mask on until he leaves.
Watch
Silver only moves when you are not watching him, and laughs when he does. Abbas skips the vents and walks straight in from Party Room 1, so keep checking CAM 01.
Light
Aziz gets restless in Parts & Service (CAM 08) when nobody checks on him, then sprints down the hallway. The mask does nothing to him: flash the light at him until he backs off.
Music box
Open the cameras, go to CAM 09 and hold Wind. If the music stops, Puffy climbs out, and nothing stops Puffy.
Look
Drag the screen to look around, or move the mouse to the edges.
Keyboard: Q mask · E cameras · hold F light · hold A / D vent lights · 1–9 and 0 cameras · hold W wind
